signature: Fun Zone: white-concrete Waiting halls of lockers and empty reception desks whose windows open on a freezing starfield, and below them the neon-lit Electric, sloping down so gently you never notice it getting colder, its doors leading to games that feed winners and punish losers.

exits.label: Staff-only door in the Waiting halls
exits.source_quote: finding staff-only doors within the Waiting halls, these will take you to Level 2
exits.hint: A plain grey door marked STAFF ONLY behind the empty reception desk.

exits.label: No-clipped through a window into the void
exits.source_quote: no-clipping through the windows, which will take you to either Level 24 or Level 78
exits.hint: The windows of the lounge; the cold is worst against the glass.

exits.label: A game door with an exit sign opened elsewhere
exits.source_quote: These have a rare chance of taking you to Level 4 , Level 21 , or Level 36 . These doors will always have an exit sign nearby.
exits.hint: One game door in the Electric has an exit sign beside it.

exits.label: Lost Asteroid Blasters
exits.source_quote: The room will either teleport one to Level 6 or manifest a Wrangler .

exits.label: Lost Lasers
exits.source_quote: The wanderer will be sent to either Level 7 or Level 154 .
exits.hint: Do not let a beam touch you.

entity_policy: SOURCE_ONLY. Entities are 'minimal' in the Waiting halls and cannot enter games; none are shown as actors. The planet/sky entity is one hallucinating narrator's TESTIMONY and is absent.
notes: ADAPTATION: the unknown-extent palace is an authored slice (Waiting halls ~50 x 46 m; the Electric three sloped runs, ~130 m, 4.4 m down) closed by doors, a dark bend and a frost-locked double door; the 1-4 days before the Electric is found are compressed into a cross hall; temperature with depth is scaled to the 4.4 m descent; games start on a lit pad; aiming is by gaze. The Level 78 window outcome, Level 21/36 game-door outcomes, Level 154, the Wrangler and Mole Holes are not built (no transitions edge or not implemented). Canon: docs/canon/levels/L020.md; authors credited there under CC BY-SA 3.0. Not yet PLAYABLE.
fail_states: Liquid Pain flood after losing Rock Climbing (damage while submerged)
deep cold without winter clothing (slow damage)
